title: Surviving in the jungle – B1+ English Listening Test

seo.title: Surviving in the jungle – B1+ English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: B1-B2 listening test. Advanced listening practice. Survival. Transcription included. Watch the video and answer the questions.

parts:
B1+ English Listening Test

Watch a video where an expert shows us how to survive in the jungle. For questions 1 to 6, choose the correct option.

See the full list of B1+ listening tests
Questions

questions.prompt: In the jungle you need to find a place to camp early ...

choices.html: because you need to protect yourself from insects.
so that you have time to find food.
because you need to prepare since the floor is too wet to sleep on.

questions.prompt: Mike wants to camp close to the river but not too close because...

choices.html: there’s a risk that rain sweeps him into the river.
he could be dragged by one of the river creatures.

questions.prompt: It’s essential to carry a lighter because ...

choices.html: magnifying lenses are totally useless in the jungle.
it’s the only way to light a fire without difficulty in the jungle.
only survival experts can easily light a fire in the jungle without one.

questions.prompt: Mike cooks food in the fire because ...

choices.html: cooks a lot of food and eats everything.
eats a little and saves a lot of food for the following days.
eats as much as he can but also saves some food.
puts out his fire before sleeping because the smoke is annoying.
doesn’t put out his fire because it keeps the place warm.
doesn’t put out his fire to keep him safer from insects and animals.
